params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment, a single instant captured mid-strike like a sculpture. A crowned king in white robes is positioned mid-swing with a stone hammer raised above a bronze serpent mounted on a pole inside a stone temple hall; fragments and smoke are suspended in the air at the point of impact. The camera performs a slow push-in toward the shattering serpent and the suspended fragments. Nothing moves -- the king's pose, the hammer, the fragments, and the smoke stay fixed exactly as drawn, frozen at this one instant. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
